Enabling entity repair or the 4v4 N' teacher would change the base the composition result was about. Internalization here is team-reward PPO on DEFEND slots only (defend_teacher_lambda=0). The scripted controller is the thing being replaced, not a distillation target.

ARCHITECTURE.pi_D: trainable, role_conditioning_enabled, warm-started from the same checkpoint via zero-init role-column expansion. DEFEND slots only. No entity-repair module.
ARCHITECTURE.k_mixture: Episode-static. At each episode start, k is drawn uniformly from {1, 3} so both compositions that the later screen will score are in the training distribution. Default k=N/2 remains the code path when this flag is absent.
ARCHITECTURE.training_opponent: Pole A only (launcher --policy A). Pole B at the later screen is transfer. This matches the 4v4 split (train on A, score both poles) and is not a claim that pi_D has seen Pole B.
